compiler: Nim 2.4.0, nim c -d:release --mm:arc; repository config; same deps
measurement: Fresh processes, alternating before/after; live malloc-zone heap, RSS and process high-water RSS; no GPU/native window
workerPayloadStrategy: Detached compact payload per request; no worker source cache
notes: Live heap includes all malloc zones and global state, not only text objects.
